description: Read actual wallet balances for up to twenty supplied token addresses on one chain and prioritize their stored ChainK9 scan verdicts. Includes scan age/staleness and missing reports. Does not discover wallet assets, run fresh scans or establish wallet-specific sellability; use exit-check for that. Costs $0.005 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

tokens.description: Comma-separated token addresses, one to twenty

name: portfolio-screen
